additional_info.body:
Hi Simen,
As we talked yesterday, the converters are in error due to KF214. When we remove the fastshutdown cables from dispenser, they are working and just reporting that the Fast shutdown was not performed.
Since we have 12V static from Output of KF214, we need to replace it.
I will forward this to your queue
Thanks and have a nice weekend.
Best regards,
Francisco
